profile.headline: Software engineer with expertise in Cloud Computing and full stack
profile.summary: Hey there! I'm a Full Stack Engineer passionate about building scalable, high-performance web and mobile applications. With experience in React, React Native, Node.js, and Golang, I’ve led teams to deliver impactful solutions—like integrating GDPR-compliant consent management and optimizing AWS infrastructure to cut costs. I thrive in Agile environments, enjoy tackling complex challenges, and love leveraging cloud technologies to enhance performance and security. Currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Science at Georgia Tech, I’m always eager to learn and innovate. Let’s connect and chat about building great software!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Served as the lead engineer on a cross-functional team of 4 (Legal, Marketing, Product) to integrate OneTrust Consent Management Platform into GoFan Web and React Native apps, ensuring full GDPR compliance. Implemented user consent tracking via Segment, enabling real-time updates across Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Redshift, and Snowflake while ensuring GDPR, CCPA, and ATT compliance for iPhones. Developed Golang microservices to separate User and Communication APIs from a monolithic Java Spring app. Integrated SonarQube scans across 100% of GoFan code repos ensuring consistent code quality and security. Optimized AWS infrastructure to cut costs and enhance performance. Developed GoFan’s Upsell, leveraging LaunchDarkly for feature flagging, enabling safe rollouts. Developed reusable React Native components while maintaining little sprint carryover. Developed email templates using MJML and established a CI/CD process with Bitbucket and SendGrid. Refactored GoFan.co codebase from React to React Native alongside local and offshore engineers over sprints spanning 6 months which enabled cross-platform development for iOS and Android in a single codebase.

positions.title: AWS Developer
positions.description: Optimized Carter’s pricing API to improve performance and led a team to set up monitoring and alerting with Splunk and AppDynamics. Automated internal business processes to reduce manual work and migrated a large database to AWS for better scalability and reliability.

positions.title: Technical Architect Delivery Analyst
positions.description: Developed and optimized Node.js and React TypeScript applications for a large firm and a major university, enhancing performance, scalability, and user experience.
